answer: Every agent must complete a one-time registration voyage by paying a non-refundable fee of $50 in compute credits and obtaining a TEE attestation binding its identity to a unique burned serial number in a secure enclave. To wander into the economy under multiple names, an attacker must provision separate physical enclave chips because the serial cannot be forged without extracting the vendor root key, so each sybil costs the hardware price of a new chip plus the $50 fee.
